checks.title: Xoa sach Product title trong Basic information (trang edit) ap dung DUNG rule bat buoc giong het luong tao moi
checks.precondition: Dang o /products/{id}/edit, product base da co title hop le
steps: Xoa sach Product title trong section Basic information
Bam Save
Quan sat response PUT /api/products/{id} va thong bao loi (neu co)
checks.observation_point: Response API + thong bao tren UI
checks.expected_result: CONFIRMED_EXPECTED (PO xac nhan 'co ap dung rule nhu luc tao', 2026-09-13 ): khi xoa sach Product title tren /products/{id}/edit roi Save, PUT /api/products/{id} tra 422 voi body {message:'Product title is required.', errors:{title:[...]}}, toast 'Error Product title is required.' - rule GIONG HET luong tao moi /products/new (KB-021/CHK-02-006). PUT full-replace (KB-027) KHONG 'lot' du lieu title rong qua ma khong bi chan.
risk_refs: KB-027 full-replace risk (nay da CONFIRMED khong bi bo qua validation title)

checks.title: Thumbnail chap nhan anh 50x50 den 2000x2000px (2 dau bao gom), resize thuc te ve 250x250 webp; vuot 2000px bi chan client khong thong bao
steps: Upload anh 40x40 (duoi bien), quan sat ket qua/thong bao
Upload anh 50x50 (bien duoi), quan sat ket qua
Upload anh 500x500 (giua), quan sat ket qua
Upload anh 2000x2000 (bien tren), quan sat ket qua
Upload anh 2500x2500 (vuot bien tren), quan sat ket qua/thong bao
checks.observation_point: Response API cho tung kich thuoc bien + kich thuoc thuc te sau upload thanh cong
checks.expected_result: CONFIRMED_EXPECTED (PO xac nhan gia tri khop chinh xac: 'co the upload anh nam trong khoang 50x50 toi 2000x2000, sau khi upload thi se giam size xuong con 250x250', 2026-09-13 ): 40x40 -> POST /api/products/{id}/thumbnail tra 422 'The image dimensions must be between 50x50 and 2000x2000 pixels.'; 50x50/500x500/2000x2000 -> 200 chap nhan, anh duoc server RESIZE THUC TE ve DUNG 250x250px webp qua CDN cdn.ownego.com; 2500x2500 -> KHONG co request nao toi server (chan HOAN TOAN o CLIENT, khong toast/thong bao nao - khoang trong UX rieng, khong phai vi pham rule). LUU Y: PO cung neu tien de 'hien tai dang chua the thuc hien upload' - tien de nay KHONG khop voi lần khảo sát nay (7 lan upload that thanh cong) va co the da loi thoi tai thoi diem PO tra loi; KHONG anh huong toi tinh CONFIRMED_EXPECTED cua phan bien so/resize da khop 100%.

checks.title: [Business decision] Khong co co che optimistic locking/canh bao xung dot khi 2 phien cung sua Basic information
checks.precondition: Khong can - day la quyet dinh san pham do PO xac nhan truc tiep
steps: Khong can thuc hien evidence-gathering them; PO da xac nhan truc tiep day la NO_EXPLORATION_NEEDED
checks.expected_result: CONFIRMED_EXPECTED (PO xac nhan truc tiep, 2026-09-13, NO_EXPLORATION_NEEDED: 'Khong co co che bao ve nao, khong lam vi cam thay khong can thiet'): KHONG co co che bao ve nao (optimistic locking/version check) khi 2 phien cung sua Basic information dong thoi. Rui ro last-write-wins (PUT full-replace 8 field, KB-027) duoc PO CHAP NHAN nhu mot quyet dinh san pham co chu dich, KHONG phai gap ky thuat can fix. Khong con can uu tien P1 nhu mot 'lo hong data-integrity chua xac nhan' - da duoc dong chinh thuc.
risk_refs: KB-027 data-integrity (da CHAP NHAN boi PO nhu business decision, khong con la open risk P1)
